title: ITN-BUET Grants Award for Immobilized Biomass Reactor Research on Textile Dye Removal & ZLD
search_description: ITN-BUET announces research grant award to North South University researchers led by Dr. Asef M. Redwan to pioneer Immobilized Biomass Packed Bed Reactors for industrial textile dye removal and Zero Liquid Discharge.
excerpt: ITN-BUET announces research grant award to North South University researchers led by Dr. Asef M. Redwan to pioneer Immobilized Biomass Packed Bed Reactors for industrial textile dye removal and Zero Liquid Discharge.
body_html:
ITN-BUET has officially approved funding for a 10-month research project titled 'Immobilized Biomass Packed Bed Reactor (IB-PBR) as a Combined Dye Removal and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) Technology from Textile Wastewater of Yarn Dyeing Facility in Bangladesh'.

Directed by Dr. Asef Mohammad Redwan as Principal Investigator alongside co-investigators from NSU CEE, the project addresses one of Bangladesh's most pressing industrial environmental challenges: treating hypersaline, recalcitrant dye effluents to effluent reuse standards.
